answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend verifiable computational energy to secure network integrity. An attacker attempting to isolate an island of fake identities faces a hard horizon of diminishing returns, as each malicious node consumes precious resources akin to carving a single marble statue. This economic cost scales linearly with identity count, ensuring that network influence remains tethered to tangible assets rather than fraudulent digital proliferation.
